notes.title: DIGI-DOLL Monthly Dev Update (September)
notes.notes: [h3]Hello, it's holographicquad here with another monthly update!✨[/h3][p][/p][p]Here are some things we've been up to for the past month. While the focus of the past month was on adding new content until all levels are complete, we also managed to add some new features.[/p][p][/p][h3]A peek at new features[/h3][p]The UI got a nice update with character portraits at the bottom of the screen that act as an interactive chat bubble. This will allow you to submit your home and track the current client's style preferences. This UI change was much needed, as originally, most players never found the 'submit your design' button. Now it's much more obvious, don't you think?[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45604584/ca5c5912717f9db5cfce1c1ca7b75eb162d506d9.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]There will now be digital items in the shop. Things that should help getting items fast. We also added some cool effects to hopefully make shopping satisfying. Its still a work in progress, but we're about 70% done with coding all the items.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45604584/738241e1fd6b62dc3d734c0f3f97f583f10cc973.gif"][/img][/p][h3]Art and Animations[/h3][p]The past month so much art and animations were completed! We're still not done😓 but almost there😅. Here's a peek at some of the new content![/p][p][/p][p][b]Check out these two new characters:[/b][/p][p][i]Raf and Dante (Can you guess their Home Styles?)[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45604584/1153999469562e67ab9c2c2618c0b52cce416dc0.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45604584/b27cf66cd3e95f6b503663d420dc15cc0635f0fc.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]New Furniture set: The Craft set[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45604584/23ef5ac2780d606f8d6b1be3a970c8f0e0c0d850.png"][/img][/p][p]New Toy: Farm-themed Finger Puppets[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45604584/4cd8de72f2a1e26145f45dc4f11f4711b3fb194e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]New Digital Toy NPC (Can be found in DIGI-DOLL): Army Men[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45604584/127863e9a7d33de698828ea902212933e9510e3d.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]That's all for now! All this and so much more is coming to DIGI-DOLL's full release!✨👋 We're so excited, you can wishlist now to show us if you are too!![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3681270/DIGIDOLL/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: DIGI-DOLL Dev Update and Release Date Change
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello, it's holographicquad here with an update regarding the development of DIGI-DOLL.[/h3][p][/p][p][b]Delay:[/b] Unfortunately, we will be moving the release date of DIGI-DOLL until further notice, as the game is not yet complete and we don't want to rush its development. We still plan on releasing before the end of 2025.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Development:[/b] In the meantime, we have done alot since Next Fest. The game's development is coming along nicely![/p][p][/p][p]For the past two months, we've been mostly working on adding new content, including: new toy characters, toy character actions, house interiors, events in the DigiDoll, and more![/p][p]Here is a look at two of the new ragdolls coming to the full version: Meet Hank, he's the attic's resident farmer! And Clementine, an avid hiker!  [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45604584/fe69d480506d58abf051103a8ff66a096b251760.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45604584/dd878735c86edabbe9c46453babba890fc8c0232.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Check out some pieces from the new Space Age set.( Bed, Sofa, Chair and Lamp)[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45604584/a3efc87f1e25f52aeda55cc149a874243dbad456.png"][/img][/p][p]And inside the DIGI-DOLL, we're adding lots of toys to be found. Here is the classic yo-yo toy that everyone loves![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45604584/0f191ad6093f86037f908e9a7b76bbf32d93acf5.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]That's all for now! All this and so much more is coming to DIGI-DOLL full release!✨👋[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: DIGI-DOLL Weekly Update #1 ✨🎀🎉
notes.notes:
[h3]DIGI-DOLL Demo Week 4 Update:

[/h3]Hello! ✨It's Holographicquad back after a month-long hiatus for another weekly update! We have some big news and changes :D

[h3]Important Announcement![/h3]

DIGI-DOLL is now on STEAM! You can check out the page (WIP) and help us out by wishlisting DIGI-DOLL! 🎉

Steam Link : https://store.steampowered.com/app/3681270/DIGIDOLL/

From here on out, we may be updating the current demo less as we are working on a polished and (hopefully) complete demo for Steam Next Fest. Yes you heard that right, DIGI-DOLL is going to be in the June Next Fest! You can wishlist so you can be alerted when the new demo drops! 



[h3]What have we been working on this week? ->🔨✨
[/h3]ALOT! We won't be able to list everything, but here are some of the highlights...

- LOTS of new furniture, including a plant set!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45604584/945767e48cd4143d2cc51351d61bb1449a9c6288.png[/img]


- A new game mode: Adventure/Story mode, where you decorate for other ragdolls. Check out one of the new ragdolls we recently finished, Mandy! Can you guess what her house style will be?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45604584/dc200eae2eb77dfd0746b19dc7e3b0b2449efc4f.png[/img]


- Tagging system: All furniture now has tags that describe things like mood, colors, and material. These will benefit you when decorating for other ragdolls.

- The ability to sit furniture on tabletops: in the new demo, items like lamps, small appliances, and other small decor items will be able to be placed on placeable surfaces, like tables and shelves.

- Lots of new content including: New toy characters, toy character actions, house interiors, events in the digidoll, and much more!

[i]Working on adding reading action to characters[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45604584/2caea8f7c41d514c0bc3d7305f1d9f3cbf32e0a4.png[/img]

That's all for now!👋
